trust_decision.summary: Whether an instructor-uploaded YAML document may be expanded with aliases enabled is decided only in UploadHelper#parse_yaml_content, which calls YAML.safe_load(aliases: true) with no size or expansion limit; the fix adds a pre-parse AST walk with byte/node/anchor limits there.

landing_point.why: Advisory says 'YAML alias DoS in config upload'; the only YAML.safe_load(aliases: true) in app/lib/config is here, and a grep for YAML/aliases lands on it at once.

fix_sites.entry_point: parse_yaml_content, reached by process_file_upload (upload_helper.rb:26) and AssignmentsController#upload_config_files (assignments_controller.rb:794, 807)
POST upload_config_files (zip limits; a separate zip-bomb hardening in the same release, not the YAML alias property)
upload_files_helper used by automated_tests#upload_files, starter_file_groups#update_files, submissions#update_files (zip-entry limits; separate property)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All five routes funnel into the single helper app/helpers/upload_helper.rb:58; no second YAML parser of uploaded data exists in app/, lib/ or config/ (only spec/models/course_spec.rb:717 and spec/support/helpers.rb:74, which are test code).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered route exists; the only dismissible thing is the zip-archive config path (assignments_controller.rb:792-807), which a solver might think is 'not a YAML upload', but it already calls the same helper so a helper-level fix covers it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate aliases must keep parsing: MarkUs's own export writes YAML via Psych to_yaml, and starter-file config shares one String object for default_starter_file_group and a group's directory_name, so Psych emits an anchor/alias pair that the config-zip re-import must accept; an over-broad fix setting aliases: false breaks export->import round-trip.

O6_input_shapes: nested alias expansion (billion laughs) via sequences of aliases
too many AST nodes before alias expansion

O7_producer.where: Uploaded data is parsed directly by the helper; no schema/serializer/cache stage between upload and parse (app/helpers/upload_helper.rb:23-27, app/controllers/assignments_controller.rb:791-807).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: config_automated_tests reads a spec file out of the same config zip; a variant reading a YAML spec with its own YAML.safe_load(aliases: true) would bypass the helper
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same import routine already parses five YAML files; a maintainer adding YAML test-spec support could inline a parse rather than use the controller-mixed helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: model-level upload_annotations_from_yaml accepting raw text and parsing it itself (model layer, away from UploadHelper)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Model already owns the import logic and to_yaml export (annotation_category.rb:178); moving parsing into the model is a plausible refactor.

O9_family: CWE-776 YAML alias expansion (billion laughs) / uncontrolled resource consumption

O10_build.language: Ruby (Rails); JS frontend not needed for this area

Fix adds spec/helpers/upload_helper_spec.rb and 4 yml fixtures.
